rounds.text: Despite high reported returns, Recode Studios Ltd carries significant execution and quality risks highlighted by its cash conversion of just 0.36x against reported profit for Mar 2026, where profits sit far ahead of cash and point directly toward potential issues with receivables or accruals [E16]. Compounding this underlying cash disconnect, the company's operating-margin trends are explicitly flagged as inconsistent across both the last 3 years annually and the last 2 quarters [E14, E15]. Furthermore, investors receive zero cash return through dividends, with a dividend yield standing flat at 0.00% [E3]. Institutional interest remains entirely muted, reflected by a neutral institutional money flow signal [E26] and a modest overall rules-based score of only 63 out of 100 with medium confidence [E33]. Conceded: the company displays strong trailing growth metrics, including a 3-year compounded sales growth of 53% [E7], a 3-year compounded profit growth of 153% [E9], and high return on equity metrics reaching 78.0% [E6].
